title: Local server hardening
statement: The system shall refuse cross-origin, non-JSON mutating and non-loopback-Host requests and require a bearer token on every API route when one is configured.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: Cross-origin, text/plain and DNS-rebinding requests are refused with 403
With REQFORGE_TOKEN set, every route including chat returns 401 without the token

A client-supplied filesystem path is accepted only if, after resolving symlinks, it is a configured component path (code scan root, impact root) or an absolute directory containing reqforge.json (project import); any other path returns 400 and 0 files are read
